hook: TraySense: a 100 KB open-source taskbar monitor
hookText: TraySense: a 100 KB open-source taskbar monitor

beats.say: DM TWEAKS launched TraySense, a tiny Windows taskbar monitor that shows CPU, GPU, RAM and VRAM usage plus CPU, GPU and SSD temperatures while using 1-3 MB of RAM.
The launch post passed 2,000 likes. CPU temperature needs the PawnIO driver, which it installs on demand.
TraySense is a single C file using plain Win32, so the exe is around 100 KB. Inspired by the amazing invention by KrisGfx.
